![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

While checking `Array.isArray(wigData)` ensures the top-level structure is an array, it does not protect against runtime crashes if individual elements are malformed or missing expected properties (such as `priceUsd` or `affiliateUrl`). For example, accessing `wig.priceUsd.toFixed(2)` or calling `getBrand(wig.affiliateUrl)` on an incomplete object will throw a runtime TypeError.

To make this guard truly robust, consider using the existing Zod schema `wigCatalogSchema` to safely parse the data at runtime.
